Delhi High Court Orders Removal of Defamatory Social Media Posts Against BJP MP

The Delhi High Court has directed the removal of five social media posts deemed defamatory against BJP MP Raghav Chadha. The court ruled that while some content was defamatory, it did not involve a violation of personality rights. This decision highlights the thin line between defamation and legitimate criticism in online discourse.
